payload.tension: The passage states prayer seeks rapid word, rescue, and directed hearts. Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you, May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and into the perseverance of Christ. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
